Hi, my name is Aaron. I'm best reached via [twitter](https://twitter.com/aarnphm) or [email](mailto:contact@aarnphm.xyz).

Nowadays, I mostly [focus](/thoughts/craft) on ML [systems](/research) (mainly distributed [inference](/thoughts/Transformers#inference) engine) and making sure _they behave well_ at [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/). My frequent interlocutors include _my close [friends](/friends)_.

As far as [aesthetic](/thoughts/aesthetic-value) goes, I enjoy [cinema](/cinematheque.base), actively avoiding cognitive [offloading](/antilibrary.base), strengthen [fast-twitching muscles](/triathlon), solving [puzzles](/queries), and [making internet zines](/vibes).

I just like writing code, and I hope to do this for as long as I can.
